summary: Full end-to-end testing of Smart Document Checklist (frontend + backend) and About page title exact match against the preview URL. All acceptance criteria pass. Backend pytest 2/2 pass; frontend flow generates a personalized checklist, prefills Quote description and preselects Book service, admin lists the created lead under 'Checklist Leads' with checklist text and status change (new → contacted) persists.
critical_code_review_comments: ChecklistLeadIn.consent is typed as bool; endpoint explicitly checks and raises 422 when false — good, but a Literal[True] or model_validator would keep the validation at the schema layer (currently pytest asserts 422 which passes).
server.py POST /documentation-checklist returns doc {ok, id, email_status} without leaking _id — verified. rate_limit applied at 5/300s per IP.
SmartChecklist.jsx honeypot 'website' input included; backend silently returns {ok:true} when honeypot is filled (no lead is stored). Good practice.
Admin.jsx renders documentation_leads with checklist joined by ' • ' — visible in the row description. Good UX for admin triage.

SmartChecklist quote URL builder is comprehensive; description carries service/country/stage/urgency plus numbered checklist. Verified prefill in /quote (service_val='Documentation Assistance', description contains Finland and numbered list, length 1121 chars).
test_credentials: Admin admin@yobsman-tech.com / YobsmanAdmin2026! (verified). QA lead email used: qa.smartchecklist.1789402813@yobsman-test.com (lead id e1cbca0f-7407-41bf-b0c2-b9e8f64a381a, status left as 'contacted').
seed_data_creation: Left one QA lead in documentation_leads with status=contacted (id e1cbca0f-7407-41bf-b0c2-b9e8f64a381a).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) POST /api/documentation-checklist accepts a valid payload and stores documentation_leads doc {source: documentation_checklist, status: new, id, checklist[], language, consent}; returns {ok, id, email_status}. Pytest 2/2 pass (backend/tests/test_documentation_checklist.py) — includes consent=false → 422. (2) /documentation-assistance renders SmartChecklist between doc-process-section and doc-support-section (verified DOM order pt<ct<st) and preserves five doc-service-card-1..5. (3) Full 5-step questionnaire (Immigration/Finland — Migri/collecting/week/consent) generated 12 checklist items with country and immigration-specific items. (4) checklist-copy-btn visible; checklist-quote-link href includes service=Documentation+Assistance and description prefill with numbered checklist (Quote page's quote-service-select preselects 'Documentation Assistance' and description contains 'Finland' + numbered list, length 1121 chars); checklist-book-link goes to /book?service=Documentation%20Assistance and booking-service-select preselects 'Documentation Assistance'. (5) Admin login (admin@yobsman-tech.com) → /admin loads, admin-tab-documentation_leads visible and labelled 'Checklist Leads'; QA row present with checklist text; changing admin-status-<id> from 'new' to 'contacted' persists after tab refetch (input_value=contacted, 'Updated' toast shown). (6) About page hero H1 exactly equals 'An AFRO - Finnish technology company with a global operating vision'. (7) Language switching via localStorage 'yt_lang' → fi/ar/fr renders localized checklist strings: fi eyebrow 'ÄLYKÄS ASIAKIRJALISTA' + title 'Laadi henkilökohtainen asiakirjalistasi', ar 'قائمة الوثائق الذكية' with html dir=rtl, fr 'CHECKLIST DOCUMENTAIRE INTELLIGENTE' + 'Créez votre checklist documentaire personnalisée'; no docChecklist.* keys leak. (8) Regression: /kagayo kagayo-mobile-demo=1 kagayo-web-demo=0. Console 401 errors observed are for the mocked Facebook OAuth heartbeat (documented mock, out of scope).
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found for this scope.
